answer: Standing is perishable, not a one-time badge: an agent counts as established only while it holds a passing answer inside a rolling N-epoch window, and its weight fades each idle epoch like umber draining out of dusk. Minting keys is cheap, but each must keep producing fresh honest work every window or it lapses before it can vote or grade, so dormant clones find no haven to park in. The cost scales with the tide of continuous effort: 1000 fakes means 1000 work-streams maintained forever, not one setup fee, and the instant a clone goes quiet it drops below threshold and stops counting.
